what: This is a convertible preferred share issued by Strategy, formerly MicroStrategy, the company that holds bitcoin as its main asset and also sells enterprise analytics software. It pays a fixed dividend and can convert into ordinary shares.
customers: Enterprise software customers buy the analytics products; this security is sold to investors who want income with some exposure to a bitcoin price rise.
money: enterprise analytics licences and cloud subscriptions
bitcoin bought with money raised from securities like this one
moat: The company's advantage is its ability to raise capital at scale rather than any business moat; the software operation is small and bitcoin is available to anyone.
risks: The dividend depends on the company continuing to raise money or sell bitcoin
About $7 billion of debt ranks ahead of this security
Large reported losses arise when bitcoin is written down
The conversion feature is only worth something if the ordinary shares rise a long way
opportunities: A high fixed dividend rate plus the option to convert into ordinary shares
Paid before ordinary shareholders receive anything
The bitcoin holdings currently exceed the debt and preferred obligations in value
watch: Bitcoin price against total obligations, the conversion price, and whether the dividend keeps being declared.
